name: Ojou-sama wa Sunao ni Narenai ~Daisuki o Kimi dake ni~
original_name: お嬢様は素直になれない ～大好きをキミだけに～
source: Fandisc for Ojou-sama wa Sunao ni Narenai. The game contains the after-stories of the 5 heroines from the original game as well a new route starring Wakaba.
translation: 《大小姐无法坦率》粉丝碟。收录原作五名女主角的后日谈，以及以若叶为主角的新路线。
